literal_meaning: চাওয়া বা ভিক্ষা করে এবং চিন্তা করে
figurative_meaning_en: By relying on others' help or assistance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চেয়ে চিন্তে জীবন যাপন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He gets by begging and borrowing from others.
The family manages day to day by seeking help from neighbors.
note: This idiom reflects everyday struggles in Bengali society, emphasizing communal support.
